messages:
nate: quick sync — I'm onboarding aurora-64b-mqa for Dedicated today. before I start full QA, can someone confirm the canonical weights path and which tokenizer variant to use? local run shows a rotary/rope freq mismatch error. cc @dmitry @alia

alia: weights are in s3://redwood-models/aurora/64b/mqa/v2/ (sha: f3a2c1). tokenizer lives at s3://redwood-models/aurora/tokenizers/bert-like/v1. use the v1 tokenizer for now, we haven't merged the bert-fix yet. :white_check_mark:

nate: thanks — that matches what I had. the error is: `rotary_freq != saved_freq (1.0 vs 0.75)`. any pointer on where we translate that?

dmitry: that mismatch indicates the model was exported with RoPE freq scaling. runtime expects `rotary_freq=1.0` by default. you can either set `rotary_freq: 0.75` in the model config or enable our compatibility shim `rope_scale: export`. small example patch: ```yaml
model:
  name: aurora-64b-mqa
  rotary_freq: 0.75
  rope_compat: export
```

sofia: note about tokenizer: the bert-like tokenizer strips certain control tokens by default which breaks prefix caching (KV). set `preserve_controls: true` in tokenizer config for serving. quick snippet: ```json
{"preserve_controls": true, "do_lower_case": false}
```

nate: got it. I'll try the `rope_compat` shim first so we don't have to flip the tokenizer immediately. any guidance on sliding-window config for long chat contexts? target is ~8k effective tokens.

dmitry: for MQA we usually set `sliding_window` to 2048 with overlap 256, then rely on KV caching to stitch. if you expect many long-context responses, bump batch_kv_ttl to 6s. metrics to watch: cache_hit_ratio and avg_decode_ms.

runtime-bot: smoke-run started for aurora-64b-mqa on dtest-03 (canary). id: run-2174925812

nate: running the smoke now. command I'm using: ```bash
rctl serve --model s3://redwood-models/aurora/64b/mqa/v2/ --config ./aurora-64b-mqa-runtime.yaml --smoke 1
```

deploy-bot: canary finished — basic inference + streaming OK (latency p50=132ms, p95=410ms). no OOMs.

sofia: FYI I opened a tiny lint PR for tokenizer flags and rope compat: https://git.redwood/infra/aurora-onboard/pulls/42 — includes the `preserve_controls` flag and a note about `rope_compat`. please review when you can. :memo:

nate: looks good. next steps: (1) test with `rotary_freq` shim enabled, (2) run eval prompts (I'll drop results later), (3) if green, schedule Dedicated canary tomorrow. thanks all. :rocket:
